title: Pull values from a shape
summary: Elixir: Pull values from a shape. Use {:ok, 6}.
introduction: The equals sign matches shapes and binds names to their parts.
learningObjectives: Pull values from a shape with Elixir

blocks.text: Install Elixir. Save each example as lesson.exs and run elixir lesson.exs.
The pattern requires :ok first, then binds the second value to score.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A shape that does not match raises a match error.
